integrated_description: Maintain compassionate support—limited to check-ins, practical help, and professional referrals—while immediately and explicitly communicating to the friend which behaviors (insults, verbal abuse, intimidation, emotional dumping during attacks) are unacceptable, what consequence follows each violation (ending the interaction and pausing contact for a defined period), and what accountability pathway (e.g., therapy) is expected within a time-limited trial. If violations persist or escalate after the boundary conversation, consequences must escalate progressively up to and including permanent cutoff, with an immediate hard cutoff warranted at any point if harassment or threats occur; the decision-maker retains the explicit right to exit at any stage without guilt.
integration_rationale: All three stakeholders requested operational specificity, immediate behavioral consequences, and an explicit exit option, which are fully compatible and mutually reinforcing additions to the core synthesis; no stakeholder requested anything that conflicts with another, allowing complete integration without compromise.
